description: v1.15 X-P1-1: dated US equity regulatory fee schedule (SEC Section 31 transaction fee and FINRA Trading Activity Fee), both charged on SELL fills of EQUITY/ETF venues only. A period applies to fills with from_ns <= exchange_ts < until_ns (UTC midnight of the ISO dates; until absent = open-ended). A fill outside every period of a table is an error (fail closed): the table only covers windows whose rate was verified against the cited notice. Applied per fill, unrounded: sec = usd_per_million * notional / 1e6; taf = min(per_share * qty, max_per_trade) (a fill stands in for a trade). Off in code defaults (v1 numbers unchanged); turned on by configs/prereg/v2.json. Verified 2026-10-11.

sec_section31.source: https://www.sec.gov/news/press-release/2019-30 (Fee Rate Advisory #2 FY2019: $20.70 per million for charge dates on/after 2019-04-16). Window closed at 2020-01-01 to cover the 2019 ITCH sample days only.
https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories/2024-2 ($8.00 per million for charge dates through 2024-05-21)
https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories/2026-2 ($20.60 per million on/after 2026-04-04, until 60 days after the FY2027 appropriation is enacted)

finra_taf.source: FINRA By-Laws Schedule A Section 1 (TAF covered equity sales $0.000119 per share, max $5.95 per trade, in force in 2019); history at https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/rule-filings/sr-finra-2024-019/fee-adjustment-schedule
https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/rule-filings/sr-finra-2024-019/fee-adjustment-schedule (2029, scheduled: $0.000249 per share, max $12.50; last year of the schedule)
